## Setup

```{python}
import altair as alt
import polars as pl

from cost_pred.db import get_connection

con = get_connection(read_only=True)
```

## Rate Distribution Overview

Summary statistics and distribution of average negotiated rates across all CDT codes.

```{python}
rates = pl.from_arrow(
    con.sql("""
        SELECT
              billing_code
            , code_desc
            , avg_negotiated_rate
            , min_negotiated_rate
            , max_negotiated_rate
            , dif_negotiated_rate
        FROM lib_dental_cost
    """).arrow()
)

rates.describe()
```

```{python}
alt.Chart(rates).mark_bar().encode(
    alt.X("avg_negotiated_rate:Q", bin=alt.Bin(maxbins=40), title="Average Negotiated Rate ($)"),
    alt.Y("count()", title="Number of Procedure Codes"),
).properties(
    title="Distribution of Average Negotiated Rates",
    width=600,
    height=350,
)
```

## Rates by Procedure Type

Compare rate distributions for procedures flagged as crown, inlay, or filling-related.

```{python}
by_type = pl.from_arrow(
    con.sql("""
        SELECT
              billing_code
            , code_desc
            , avg_negotiated_rate
            , contains_crown
            , contains_inlay
            , contains_filling
        FROM lib_dental_cost
    """).arrow()
)

type_long = by_type.unpivot(
    on=["contains_crown", "contains_inlay", "contains_filling"],
    index=["billing_code", "code_desc", "avg_negotiated_rate"],
    variable_name="procedure_type",
    value_name="matches",
).filter(pl.col("matches") == True).with_columns(
    pl.col("procedure_type").str.replace("contains_", "").alias("procedure_type")
)
```

```{python}
alt.Chart(type_long).mark_boxplot(extent="min-max").encode(
    alt.X("procedure_type:N", title="Procedure Type"),
    alt.Y("avg_negotiated_rate:Q", title="Average Negotiated Rate ($)"),
    alt.Color("procedure_type:N", legend=None),
).properties(
    title="Rate Distribution by Procedure Type",
    width=400,
    height=350,
)
```

## Rate Spread Analysis

Which procedures have the largest gap between minimum and maximum negotiated rates? High spread indicates significant pricing variability across providers.

```{python}
spread = pl.from_arrow(
    con.sql("""
        SELECT
              billing_code
            , code_desc
            , min_negotiated_rate
            , max_negotiated_rate
            , dif_negotiated_rate
            , avg_negotiated_rate
        FROM lib_dental_cost
        ORDER BY dif_negotiated_rate DESC
    """).arrow()
)

spread.head(15)
```

```{python}
top_spread = spread.head(20)

alt.Chart(top_spread).mark_bar().encode(
    alt.X("dif_negotiated_rate:Q", title="Rate Spread (Max - Min, $)"),
    alt.Y("billing_code:N", sort="-x", title="CDT Code"),
    alt.Color("avg_negotiated_rate:Q", scale=alt.Scale(scheme="blues"), title="Avg Rate ($)"),
    alt.Tooltip(["billing_code", "code_desc", "min_negotiated_rate", "max_negotiated_rate", "dif_negotiated_rate"]),
).properties(
    title="Top 20 Procedures by Negotiated Rate Spread",
    width=600,
    height=450,
)
```

```{python}
con.close()
```
